text_block_list.text:
Today is the first day of summer camp.
It's a
period of intense training where
racers can
improve their skills.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Hnnngh... Maybe I shouldn't be here
after all.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
There are so many racers here. What if
my bad
luck causes something to ha—

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
choice_data_list: 今、考えるべきことは違うよ？
今、考えるべきことは違うでしょ？

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
I need to focus. That way I can beat
Bourbon in
the Kikuka Sho... Right?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe... All I did was say my goal out
loud.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Heheh. All right... do your best this
summer, Rice!
Here we go!
